release_name: Complete Operating Layer - Unified Cloud Workspace

local_regression.android_companion_compile: static-contract-validated; Android SDK/Gradle build is host-side

managed_omniparser.minimal_upstream_openai_import_dependenc: openai==1.3.5; import compatibility only, no cloud model call required

completion_hardening.connectors: authorization/expiry fail-closed with fixed-host vault-backed adapters
completion_hardening.signed_skills: manifest plus every package file hash is Ed25519 authenticated
completion_hardening.control_surfaces: complete model-facing v5 tool surface plus web status matrix
completion_hardening.unified_cloud_workspace: shared restart-safe client presence, active thread, transcript and non-secret preferences across Windows/web/Android

hotfixes.local_device_bridge_contract: shared request metadata accepted locally; remote-session provenance remains rejected
hotfixes.spotify_fastpath: device_spotify_play local CLI path no longer raises unexpected remote_session_id TypeError
hotfixes.omniparser_dependencies: headless runtime excludes conflicting demo/cloud/dev packages
hotfixes.omniparser_ownership: Windows persisted PID probing hardened for cross-process managed ownership
hotfixes.risk_based_local_approvals: routine local Spotify/media/WhatsApp-open/scroll actions auto-run at SAFE_ACTION; consequential actions retain approval; remote classification unchanged
hotfixes.spotify_startup_sequencing: Spotify play now uses open/focus -> visual readiness -> search -> search readiness -> play with URI/green-button fallbacks
hotfixes.omniparser_repair_weights: repair reuses live detector/Florence assets in place instead of deleting memory-mapped model.safetensors
hotfixes.approval_input: interactive risky-action prompts accept common affirmative forms such as yes/yep/okay/approve
hotfixes.omniparser_optional_cleanup: PowerShell 5.1 stderr warnings from optional pip-uninstall cleanup no longer abort setup; native exit code is handled explicitly
hotfixes.omniparser_extras_filter: headless dependency filter now excludes extras forms such as anthropic[bedrock,vertex] as well as bare package names
hotfixes.omniparser_full_device_control: IRAS full parser now constructs YOLO/Florence on the configured device instead of upstream auto-CUDA selection; unsupported legacy CUDA capability falls back to CPU
hotfixes.omniparser_empty_ocr_guard: full visual parse survives icon-only/low-text screenshots affected by upstream empty-OCR None iteration
hotfixes.omniparser_full_diagnostics: vision status exposes full model state/device/warmup/error and setup prints HTTP failure detail
hotfixes.florence_remote_code_cache: setup pre-caches microsoft/Florence-2-base-ft remote implementation used by the icon-caption model config
hotfixes.spotify_semantic_verification: after Play, IRAS reads Spotify UIA state and only marks playback verified when Pause state and query-related evidence are visible
hotfixes.spotify_semantic_result_selection: Spotify no longer treats Shift+Enter as playback proof; it selects a query-matched UIA result, uses semantic/content Play with visual fallback, and requires visible playing state before success.
hotfixes.spotify_pause_truth: A connected Spotify device or successful shortcut is not considered playback; IRAS fails closed when the visible transport remains Play/paused.
hotfixes.omniparser_openai_import: Managed OmniParser retains the minimal openai==1.3.5 package required by upstream imports while excluding cloud/demo stacks and making no cloud model calls.
hotfixes.spotify_quick_search_overlay: After selecting a semantic result, IRAS detects and dismisses Spotify Quick Search before touching content playback controls so the Chromium overlay cannot intercept the Play action.
hotfixes.spotify_uia_invoke: Content Play prefers the existing audited Windows UI Automation InvokePattern/LegacyIAccessible default action, then scoped mouse/Space fallbacks, with visible playing-state verification after every attempt.
hotfixes.spotify_query_bound_playback: Query playback uses Spotify search URI first, ranks multiple semantic results, retries candidates, and activates only result-bound UIA/content Play controls; global Space/media-resume and unanchored green-button fallbacks are forbidden.
hotfixes.spotify_now_playing_truth: Playback verification scopes query evidence to the right now-playing panel/bottom transport metadata so library/search text cannot validate an unrelated active track.
hotfixes.spotify_error_toast_rejection: Spotify can't-play-this-right-now/local-file toast is detected as a hard failure and IRAS retries another query-matched candidate instead of accepting Pause state.
hotfixes.unified_cloud_workspace: Windows cloud client, web/PWA and Android share persistent cloud thread/history/client presence without moving local device-control enforcement into the public server.
hotfixes.cloud_turn_retry_deduplication: Web Remote-authorization continuation reuses one turn_id so retrying the same user turn cannot duplicate cloud transcript entries.
hotfixes.cloud_thread_context: Direct cloud chat uses request-scoped cloud thread history instead of leaking recent messages from another cloud thread.
hotfixes.cross_device_message_sync: Web and Android poll the active cloud workspace and merge only unseen persisted message IDs.

release_notes: Unified cloud workspace shared across Windows, web and Android clients.

unified_cloud_workspace.persistent_backend: PostgreSQL when DATABASE_URL is configured; SQLite locally
